objective: 把existing Strategy structural-progress facts作为accepted Run相关性输入接入ledger且绝不改变计数或完成权威

semantic_brief.summary: 复用Agent现有pre-terminal StrategyExecutionEvidenceView，在同一Agent owner下仅保留已接受的结构进度相关性，并让ledger compiler fail closed验证后只写入digest correlation。
core_points: Agent仅保留通过现有checkpoint验证与commit的accepted view
structural facts只影响correlation digest不影响五类计数
结构进度不能创建GoalEvidence或推动FSM/completion

change_principles: 不得创建新的public fact/view/schema或Evidence owner；复用existing StrategyExecutionEvidenceView，Agent仍是唯一Run/evidence owner
Agent只有在PreTerminalCheckpointValidator接受、evaluator.TryCommit成功且Run仍Running后，才可保留该次immutable StrategyExecutionEvidenceView作为latest accepted correlation；失败/拒绝/legacy不保留
Agent.CompileExplorationLedgerView把latest accepted view作为optional internal compiler input；没有accepted view是显式valid absence，不得synthetic per-scope fact

compiler重复fail-closed验证view RunId与AcceptedExplorationRunContext.RunId、RuntimeExecutionIntentReference、defined kind、non-negative/non-decreasing fact revision、fact revision不大于view.StructuralProgressRevision、nonblank EvidenceReference；现有constructor已拒绝的非法值测试其既有边界

结构facts及其accepted view correlation以canonical material参与ExplorationLedgerView digest/equality；不得写入scope identity partition或SourceObservationSequence，不得改变Discovered/Visited/Pending/Unresolved/UnknownFrontier
显式empty fact set有效；相同scope evidence在absent/empty/valid facts三种输入下五类计数完全相同，但合法不同correlation产生不同digest
真实Strategy Agent测试证明accepted structural view可随ledger投影且unsatisfied GoalEvidence时Run仍Failed；ledger/structural facts不得调用FSM、GoalEvidence、completion、authorization、dispatch或Traversal
acceptance: unit test以同一identity evidence比较absent view、explicit empty facts和valid correlated facts，五类counts与SourceObservationSequence逐项相同
valid facts按canonical order进入digest；相同facts不同输入枚举顺序保持同digest，fact kind/revision/reference或accepted evidence digest变化时digest变化

mismatched RunId、mismatched RuntimeExecutionIntentReference、non-monotonic revisions分别在compiler fail closed；undefined kind、negative revision、blank reference继续由existing StrategyStructuralProgressFact constructor fail closed
fact revision ahead of view progress继续由existing StrategyExecutionEvidenceView constructor fail closed；explicit empty facts合法
真实Strategy run产生的latest accepted view与bound context Run/reference一致且ledger可编译；legacy没有该view且不能编译Strategy ledger
evidenceSatisfied=false真实Strategy run即使存在structural facts仍保持Failed并保留unsatisfied GoalEvidence reason，不从ledger/facts完成
原91个定向回归加新增structural测试全部通过，Runtime build 0 error且git diff仅scope.write
forbidden: 禁止修改StrategyExecutionEvidenceView或StrategyStructuralProgressFact公开shape、Strategy wire/schema或protocol version
禁止新增结构进度owner、持久化、FSM state、GoalEvidence fact、completion path或Runtime loop
禁止从structural fact推导node identity、Visited、exhaustion、target、action、authorization或scenario meaning
禁止修改Planning、Agent.OpenWorld、Traversal、FSM、GoalEvidence、OpenSpec、文档、WorkItem或其他已有改动
escalation: 若复用existing evidence view不足且需要新public contract、owner或状态系统，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
若accepted view无法在existing checkpoint acceptance之后由Agent保留，列出真实lifecycle缺口并停止，不得提前记录未接受evidence
若structural facts影响现有GoalEvidence/FSM/terminal outcome，保留反例并返回Leader
